description: Add a new note to a trading day — any day, traded or not; `date` is YYYY-MM-DD in the journal timezone. Days hold any number of notes, so this never overwrites: to change an existing note use journal_update_note, and for a note about one specific trade use journal_update_trade's `notes`. Returns the note with its id. Requires signing in with a LuxAlgo account (OAuth).

body.description: The note text (plain text or markdown).

date.description: The day the note belongs to, YYYY-MM-DD in the journal timezone.

name: journal_write_note
title: Write a journal note
